categories.main_business_segments: Want Want China Holdings Limited operates primarily in four business segments: rice crackers (including sugar coated, savoury, fried crackers, and gift packs), dairy products and beverages (including flavoured milk, yogurt, ready-to-drink coffee, juice drinks, sports drinks, herbal tea, and milk powder), snack foods (including candies, popsicles, biscuits, jellies, beans, nuts, and others), and other products mainly comprising wine and other food products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced food science and technology in product development, including innovative 'black technology' for peeling in gummy products and post-aseptic homogenisation technology in dairy products. It emphasizes lean production, automation, supply chain optimization, and sustainable manufacturing practices such as green factory certifications and zero-carbon initiatives to enhance production efficiency and environmental sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are diverse consumers across various age groups in the Chinese Mainland, supported by a nationwide sales and distribution network. The Group also serves overseas markets including North America, East Asia, Southeast Asia, Europe, and has emerging channels like e-commerce and OEM. Key consumer segments include infants, seniors, young white-collar workers, and gym-goers, targeted through differentiated brands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's operations are predominantly in the Chinese Mainland, with over 90% of revenue and non-current assets located there. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and production bases in Vietnam, Indonesia, Australia, Germany, Japan, North America, and Southeast Asia, supporting international sales and localized operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Want Want operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing, distribution, and sales of food and beverage products. It also manages upstream activities such as raw material procurement and packaging manufacturing through its subsidiaries, ensuring control over quality and supply chain resilience.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes innovation in product development with a focus on health-conscious and differentiated products, such as low-sugar beverages, probiotic snacks, and functional drinks. It invests in R&D capabilities to develop personalized brands targeting different demographics and continuously upgrades production facilities to support sustainable growth and market responsiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of rice crackers, dairy products and beverages, snack foods, and other food products. The Group leverages multiple sales channels including traditional wholesale, modern retail, e-commerce, OEM, and overseas distribution to diversify revenue streams and enhance market penetration.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Want Want is positioned as a leading diversified food and beverage company in China with strong brand recognition and innovation capabilities. It holds a significant market share supported by extensive distribution networks, product diversification, and international expansion, distinguishing itself through sustainable manufacturing and product innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB23.51 billion, with a slight decline of 0.3% year-on-year. Profit attributable to equity holders increased by 8.6% to RMB4.34 billion, with a gross profit margin of 47.6%. The Group maintains a strong financial position with net cash of RMB11.28 billion and continues to invest in capital expenditures to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Want Want emphasizes delivering high-quality, innovative, and health-oriented food products that cater to diverse consumer needs across age groups. Its value proposition includes product differentiation through unique flavors, functional benefits like probiotics, and sustainable practices such as green manufacturing and zero-carbon factories, enhancing brand loyalty and consumer engagement.
